title: Accept TSO (DEC-0012) and record openraft as the Raft library
rationale: PO approved proceeding on the TASK-0003/0009 drafts on 2026-10-07. Implementation (TASK-0004) found that raft-rs 0.7.0, its latest crates.io release, pulls protobuf 2.28 (RUSTSEC-2024-0437) and fxhash (RUSTSEC-2025-0057, unmaintained), fails cargo-deny, and its build script rejects current protoc; TiKV uses it from git, which deny.toml forbids. openraft 0.9.25 is pure Rust, passes cargo-deny and the native allow-list, and its storage-v2 API lets the log store complete appends only after fsync, so fsync-before-ack and cross-group batching stay in DS-CORE code. design/raft-ranges.md §4 is updated to match.

data.title: openraft as the Raft implementation
data.context: TASK-0003 recommended raft-rs; TASK-0004 found raft-rs 0.7.0 fails the advisory gate (protobuf 2.28 RUSTSEC-2024-0437, fxhash RUSTSEC-2025-0057) and does not build with current protoc. DS-CORE runs many Raft groups per store and must fsync before ack (REQ-0016).
data.decision: Use openraft 0.9 (stable line) with the storage-v2 API. The RocksDB log store signals append completion only after the store-wide fsync, so a node counts toward a quorum only for entries it has made durable; appends from many groups share one synced WriteBatch. Joint consensus and learners come from openraft's membership API. Revisit when openraft 0.10 is stable.
